title: SYNTHETIC DEMO — Urgent cardiorespiratory finding: verification and escalation workflow
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION PROCEDURE. Not a NASA or mission-approved medical procedure. Contains no treatment instructions. In a real mission the crew follows the mission-approved medical checklist referenced below.
verification_checklist: Sensor placement and contact checked on the wearable
Heart rate repeated with a second, independent device
SpO2 repeated with a second pulse oximeter (finger warm and still)
Symptoms confirmed directly with the crew member (onset time recorded)
Crew Medical Officer notified
steps: Alert the Crew Medical Officer (CMO) and the rest of the crew now.
Open the mission-approved medical checklist for this situation. [PLACEHOLDER: mission procedure reference to be supplied by the flight surgeon team]
Complete the verification checklist and record each item in ASTRA.
Record what the crew member reports (symptoms, severity, onset time).
Use 'Escalate' to notify ground flight surgeons. If the Earth link is unavailable the medical report is queued and sent automatically when the link returns.
Continue observations as directed by the CMO; ASTRA links new measurements to this event.

title: SYNTHETIC DEMO — Finding referred for medical review
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION PROCEDURE. Not mission-approved. No treatment instructions.
verification_checklist: Measurement quality reviewed (device, context, technique)
Relevant history reviewed in ASTRA
Crew Medical Officer informed
steps: Inform the Crew Medical Officer at the next opportunity.
Review the findings, baseline comparison and source observations shown by ASTRA.
Add the item to the next private medical conference or send the generated medical report to ground.
Record the outcome and any follow-up observations requested by medical personnel.

title: SYNTHETIC DEMO — Repeat / verify a measurement
verification_checklist: Device and sensor checked
Measurement context recorded (rest, posture, activity)
Measurement repeated
steps: Check the device (fit, battery, sensor contact).
Rest quietly for a few minutes if the measurement should be a resting value.
Repeat the measurement and enter it in ASTRA.
If the repeated value confirms the change, ASTRA re-evaluates and may recommend medical review.

title: SYNTHETIC DEMO — Possible illness observations
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION PROCEDURE. Not mission-approved. No treatment instructions.
verification_checklist: Temperature repeated with the same method
Symptom onset time and duration recorded
Crew Medical Officer informed
steps: Inform the Crew Medical Officer.
Record symptoms with onset time and repeat temperature as directed.
Follow the mission-approved infection-control procedure. [PLACEHOLDER: mission procedure reference]
Medication only per approved medical instructions from authorized medical personnel.

title: SYNTHETIC DEMO — Elevated radiation dose rate
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION PROCEDURE. Not a mission-approved radiation flight rule.
verification_checklist: Reading compared with a second dosimeter / area monitor
Space-weather notification checked
Flight director / ground notified
steps: Compare the reading with other dosimeters and area monitors.
Notify the commander and ground radiation support.
Follow the mission-approved radiation event (shelter) procedure. [PLACEHOLDER: mission flight rule reference]
Keep dosimeters active; ASTRA records the event and cumulative exposure.

title: SYNTHETIC DEMO — Cabin CO2 above NASA-STD-3001 [V2 6004] habitat limit
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION PROCEDURE. Environmental warning workflow only.
verification_checklist: Sensor reading compared with another CO2 sensor
Life-support team / ground informed
Crew asked about headaches or other symptoms
steps: Verify the reading with another sensor.
Inform the crew and life-support operators per mission procedure.
Record any symptoms (e.g. headache) in ASTRA so they can be reviewed alongside the environmental record.

title: SYNTHETIC DEMO — Private behavioral-health follow-up
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION PROCEDURE. PRIVATE — not shown to other crew members. Self-reported scores are not a diagnosis.
verification_checklist: Astronaut offered a private medical conference
Flight surgeon / psychological support informed through private channel
steps: Offer the astronaut a private medical or psychological conference.
Share the private report only with authorized medical personnel.
Do not discuss the content with other crew members unless the astronaut agrees.
